about: The mutant ledger of scripts/langmigrate: edits of the tool and of the lowering sites whose shape it relies on (q105: parentheses carry no meaning), which TestTryParensIsIdempotent must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants scripts/langmigrate.

mutants.name: try1-tool-accepts-unchecked
mutants.from: if got, ok := lowered(cand); ok && got == want {
mutants.to: if got, ok := lowered(cand); ok || got == want {
mutants.rule: tryparens removes a (try …) only when the lowered Go stays the same.

mutants.name: try1-tool-any-paren
mutants.rule: tryparens removes only parentheses round a try.

mutants.name: try1-tool-columns-compared
mutants.rule: A removal moves columns, not meaning: the call-site columns are not compared.

mutants.name: try1-tool-assert-text-compared
mutants.rule: An assert quotes its source text; the spelling is not the meaning.

mutants.name: try1-tool-call-rows-ordered
mutants.rule: The call-site table is in offset order; a removal may reorder two rows of a line.

mutants.name: try1-assert-shown-not-tried
mutants.rule: q105: parentheses carry no meaning: assert try a == b shows a and b as assert (try a) == b does.

mutants.name: try1-assert-tried-untried
mutants.rule: A try that starts an assert covers the operands of its shown comparison.

mutants.name: try1-assert-naming-disagrees
mutants.from: if _, lt, rt, shown := l.assertShown(a.X); shown {
mutants.to: if _, lt, rt, shown := l.assertShown(unparen(a.X)); shown && tried(a.X) == a.X {
mutants.rule: The naming pass and the assert lowering ask assertShown the same question, through a starting try.

mutants.name: try1-getmatch-not-tried
mutants.rule: q105: match try m.Get(k) lowers to the comma-ok read as match (try m).Get(k) does.

mutants.name: try1-getmatch-tried-untried
mutants.rule: A try that starts a matched Get covers its receiver and key.
